newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: British mining company Oxus plans Toronto listing.
newsitem.headline: British mining company Oxus plans Toronto listing.

text.p: British mining company Oxus Resources Corporation, which is prospecting for gold in Uzbekistan, plans to list on the Toronto Stock Exchange in November, a company representative said on Tuesday.

"We're hoping to raise about $12 million in an initial public offering on the Toronto exchange in November," Richard Wilkins, the company's commercial director, told Reuters at a site in Uzbekistan's Khandiza Valley.
The company is exploring and planning to mine gold properties in the former Soviet republics of Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and Kazakhstan.
But most of the cash is earmarked to develop its Khandiza base metal deposit, located in southeast Uzbekistan.
Wilkins said Khandiza requires $104 million in capital costs and would produce about 85,000 tonnes per year (tpy) of zinc, 36,000 tpy of lead and 11,000 tpy of copper.
"It will take about three to four years to bring Khandiza into production," Wilkins said.
The company aims to produce its own base metal concentrates and is negotiating with smelters in Uzbekistan and neighbouring Kazakhstan to process the concentrates.
